title: Crew Briefing: Pairing HCA-4471
key_sentences: A cold front will cross Kestrel Bay between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC with gusts up to 35 knots.
Expect moderate turbulence below 8,000 feet on the approach to Kestrel Bay.
Report any fatigue concerns to crew control before signing on for duty.
This briefing package is valid only for the duty date shown and must not be reused.

list_items.text: • Captain to brief the crosswind limits before departure from Port Alder.
• Catering for HC 517 includes 4 special meals; confirm loading with the dispatcher.
• Cabin crew to complete the security search of the aircraft before the first sector.
